types.name: ClaimWindowOpened
docs: Emitted when a pool transitions Active → Claiming (lazy, on first claim call).

types.name: EarlyExit
docs: Emitted when a player exits early from an Active pool (penalized).

types.name: FillingWithdraw
docs: Emitted when a player withdraws during the Filling phase (no penalty).
pool_closed = true if this was the last player and the pool auto-closed.

types.name: GlobalState
docs: Singleton PDA. One per program deployment.
Tracks the global rollover vault and pool counter.
PDA seeds: ["global"]

fields.name: authority
docs: Authority that can manage the protocol.

fields.name: token_mint
docs: The canonical THEO token mint for this deployment.
All pools must use this mint. Validated at pool creation and deposit.

fields.name: rollover_vault
docs: Token account PDA holding global rollover vault funds.
Seeded into the next pool created.

fields.name: rollover_balance
docs: Running balance of tokens in the global rollover vault (raw units).

fields.name: pool_count
docs: Total number of pools ever created (monotonically increasing).
Used as the next pool_id on creation.

fields.name: active_filling_pool
docs: The pool_id of the currently open Filling pool, if any.
Set when a new pool is created. Cleared when pool goes Active or Closed
(deposit, withdraw, close_stalled_pool).
Enforces the single-filling-pool-at-a-time invariant on-chain.

fields.name: bump
docs: PDA bump for ["global"]

fields.name: _reserved
docs: Reserved for future fields without account migration.
Note: Option<u64> consumes 9 bytes, token_mint Pubkey consumes 32 bytes.

types.name: PlayerJoined
docs: Emitted when a player joins a Filling pool.

types.name: Pool
docs: One PDA per pool. Pools are disposable; the program is permanent.
PDA seeds: ["pool", id.to_le_bytes()]

fields.name: id
docs: Monotonic pool identifier (0-indexed).

fields.name: token_mint
docs: The THEO token mint this pool accepts.

fields.name: vault
docs: Token account PDA holding this pool's staked funds.

fields.name: player_count
docs: Number of players who have joined (and not withdrawn during Filling).

fields.name: survivor_count
docs: Number of players who have not exited early.
Decrements on each early_exit(). Used for floor(P / W) at claim time.

fields.name: penalty_vault_balance
docs: Reward pot (raw units): rollover seed + accumulated early-exit penalties.

fields.name: fill_deadline
docs: Deadline by which the pool must reach MAX_PLAYERS.
Set at creation (= creation time + FILL_TIMEOUT) and reset to
now + FILL_TIMEOUT on every deposit.
Legacy pools created before the creation-time rule hold 0 until their first join.

fields.name: start_time
docs: Unix timestamp when the pool transitioned to Active.

fields.name: end_time
docs: Unix timestamp when the 90-day lock expires (= start_time + GAME_DURATION).

fields.name: claim_deadline
docs: Unix timestamp when the claim window closes (= end_time + CLAIM_WINDOW).

fields.name: status
docs: Current lifecycle state.

fields.name: rollover_seed
docs: Rollover seed transferred from GlobalState when this pool was created.
Tracked separately to allow recovery if pool stalls (rule 6B).

fields.name: reward_per_survivor
docs: Penalty share per survivor = floor(penalty_vault_balance / survivor_count).
Computed when pool enters Claiming. Frozen for all subsequent claims.
Full claim amount = STAKE_AMOUNT + reward_per_survivor.
claimed_total tracks penalty payouts only (not stake principal).

fields.name: claimed_count
docs: Number of survivors who have successfully claimed.
Used at finalization to compute unclaimed redistribution.

fields.name: claimed_total
docs: Total tokens paid out to claimers so far.

fields.name: redistribution_per_claimer
docs: Per-claimer redistribution amount computed at finalize time.
= floor((penalty_vault_balance - (claimed_count * reward_per_survivor)) / claimed_count)
Survivors who claimed call collect_redistribution() to pull this amount.

fields.name: redistribution_dust
docs: Floor division dust from redistribution calculation.
= (penalty_vault_balance - (claimed_count * reward_per_survivor)) % claimed_count
Rolled into GlobalState.rollover_balance at finalize time. Never silently lost.

fields.name: finalized
docs: Set true by finalize(). Always equal to (status == Finalized) — redundant,
but kept so the account layout stays compatible with already-deployed pools.

fields.name: bump
docs: PDA bump for ["pool", id.to_le_bytes()]

types.name: PoolActivated
docs: Emitted when a pool transitions Filling → Active (10th player joins).

types.name: PoolClosed
docs: Emitted when a stalled Filling pool is closed.
Via close_stalled_pool: rollover_returned = 0 (no tokens moved).
Via withdraw (last player): rollover_returned = rollover_seed (tokens returned).
Both can fire for the same pool (close_stalled_pool, then the last withdraw).

types.name: PoolCreated
docs: Emitted when a new pool is created.

types.name: PoolFinalized
docs: Emitted when a pool is finalized after the claim window closes.

types.name: PoolStatus
docs: Strict one-directional lifecycle. Two terminal states:
Filling → Active → Claiming → Finalized      (pool filled)
Filling → Closed                             (pool stalled)
A Filling pool whose fill timer expires never reaches Active. It becomes
Closed via close_stalled_pool, or via the last withdraw after expiry.
Players withdraw their full stake from a Closed pool at any time.

types.name: PositionClosed
docs: Emitted when a player closes their position in a Finalized pool.

types.name: RedistributionCollected
docs: Emitted when a survivor collects their redistribution bonus after finalization.

types.name: RewardClaimed
docs: Emitted when a survivor successfully claims their base reward.
amount = STAKE_AMOUNT + reward_per_survivor (penalty share).

types.name: UserPosition
docs: One PDA per (player, pool) pair.
PDA seeds: ["position", pool_id.to_le_bytes(), owner.as_ref()]

fields.name: owner
docs: The player's wallet pubkey.

fields.name: pool
docs: The pool PDA this position belongs to.

fields.name: pool_id
docs: The pool's numeric ID. Stored for cheap off-chain queries and event logging.

fields.name: amount
docs: Stake currently held for this position: STAKE_AMOUNT (20 raw units) after
deposit, 0 once it has been paid out (claim).

fields.name: deposited_at
docs: Unix timestamp of deposit.

fields.name: withdrew_filling
docs: True if the player withdrew during the Filling phase (no penalty).
Distinct from exited_early — that flag is strictly for Active-phase exits.
withdraw now closes the position, so this is only ever true on legacy accounts.

fields.name: exited_early
docs: True if the player called early_exit() during the Active window.
early_exit now closes the position, so this is only ever true on legacy accounts.

fields.name: claimed
docs: True if the survivor successfully called claim() during the claim window.

fields.name: redistribution_collected
docs: True if the survivor has collected their redistribution bonus via collect_redistribution().
Separate from claimed — redistribution is a second pull after finalize().

fields.name: bump
docs: PDA bump for ["position", pool_id.to_le_bytes(), owner.as_ref()]

types.name: VaultSwept
docs: Emitted when sweep_empty_vault moves a Closed, empty pool's remaining vault
balance to the GlobalState rollover vault.
